objectives.description: Apply year/DOI/venue secondary check to each search-candidate
Auto-approve rule (exact year match AND similarity >= 0.85), threshold recorded
Route non-approved candidates to needs-confirmation/rejected with rationale
Write decisions back to manifest; verify no absent/matched-no-pdf approved

approaches_tried.reason: 9 entries have null id; jq {(.id): .year} on a null key throws 'Cannot use null as object key', aborting the whole transform silently truncated the destination file via shell redirection before the error was caught

deviations.description: Route every other search-candidate to needs-confirmation
deviations.reason: pnueli_1977 and een_2011 are unambiguous false positives (wrong author entirely / wrong subject domain via substring collision), distinct from fine_2014's genuinely ambiguous year-drift case. Routed to decision: rejected instead of needs-confirmation to avoid queuing dispositively-wrong matches for human review, while keeping fine_2014 (the one case the plan explicitly calls out as ambiguous) in needs-confirmation.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: fine_2014 correctly routed to needs-confirmation per spec. The other two ... routed to decision: rejected ... see plan Phase 4 task annotation)*

incident_note: During this phase, an intermediate jq transform attempt (with a bug: null-id entries as object keys) errored mid-pipeline, and the shell redirect truncated specs/836_recover_source_pdfs_via_zotero/artifacts/resolution-manifest.json to 0 bytes. Recovered fully from the still-intact /tmp/zotero-sweep/*.json per-doc_id sweep outputs (52 files, unaffected) by re-aggregating and re-applying the (corrected) decision transform in a scratch file, validating with `jq empty`, and only then overwriting the real manifest path. No task-dir artifact was lost as a result -- the underlying per-doc_id resolver outputs were the source of truth throughout, not the aggregated manifest file itself. No corpus file (~/Projects/Literature) was involved in this incident.
